tests.title: Sign in with the .env account downloads the device data and opens the Dashboard
tests.goal: The app accepts an HTX LIMS web account, downloads the device data and opens the Dashboard for that user.
preconditions: Upload queue empty (logging out deletes every record on the device that is not uploaded)

steps.text: If signed in: check the Upload queue is empty, then Logout > Log out
On "Welcome back", enter the .env username and password, tap Sign in
Tap OK on the "Data downloaded" dialog

expected.text: "Data downloaded" lists Pre Check-in list (new + loan), Storage locations and Stocktake lists & items with counts
Dashboard opens; the bottom bar shows the user's name and username

notes: After the 19/11 deploy: ADMIN, QADEL539047 and ADMIN again signed in; each sign-in showed "Data downloaded" (Pre Check-in list 18-19, Storage locations 6, Stocktake 3 lists / 7 items) and the Dashboard.

tests.title: Pre check-in a printed item by tag ID on the handheld
tests.goal:
Pre check-in

Verify that a registered item with a printed tag can be pre checked-in on the handheld and then shows as NOT CHECKED IN on the web.
preconditions: A registered item whose tag is printed and that is not pre checked-in yet

steps.text: On the handheld Dashboard tap Update all data, then Pre Check-in
Enter the chip code under Or enter EPC / Tag ID and tap Add tag
Verify the tag (scan it, or Simulate verify read on a device without a reader), tap Next · Review items
Count the items (Burst scan or Simulate burst scan) and tap Upload pre check-in
On the web open Check In / Out > Tagged Not Checked In and Count Item

expected.text: The card shows the item number, type, category and New item
Upload shows "Pre check-in uploaded - All 1 tag(s) were pre checked-in."
The web lists the item under Tagged Not Checked In and Count Item with status NOT CHECKED IN

notes: Pre check-in by typed chip code: 002000025 (10:39) and 002000026 (14:12): "New item" card, Simulate verify read, review, Simulate burst scan -> Counted, Upload -> "All 1 tag(s) were pre checked-in."; web Tagged Not Checked In lists them.

tests.title: Check in pre checked-in items on the handheld with a location per item
tests.goal:
Handheld check-in

Verify that pre checked-in items are checked in on the handheld at the chosen storage location and become IN.
preconditions: Items with status NOT CHECKED IN
data: Locations: Airlock 1 (default) and Chemistry for one item

steps.text: On the handheld tap Check-in and Refresh items
For each item enter its number, tap Find item, then Add to check-in
Verify each item (scan or Simulate verify read) and change one item's Location to Chemistry
Tap Next · Review items, count (Burst scan) and Upload check-in

expected.text: On the web each item is IN at its chosen location (Item Information)
Audit Trail: "Handheld check-in ... Location: <code>" per item

notes: Check-in by item number with location Airlock 1: 002000025 and 002000026 -> "1 item(s) checked in."; web Item Information IN at Airlock 1, Audit Trail Handheld check-in with Location 00001.

tests.title: A User-role account signs in on the handheld
tests.goal:
User role on the handheld

Verify that an account with the User role can sign in on the handheld, downloads the device data and sees its name in the bottom bar.
preconditions: An account with the User role
Upload queue empty (signing out deletes device data)

steps.text: On the handheld check that the Upload queue is empty, then Logout > Log out
Sign in with the User account and tap OK on Data downloaded

expected.text: Data downloaded lists the Pre Check-in list, storage locations and stocktake lists
The Dashboard shows the user's name and username in the bottom bar and the task tiles

notes: QADEL539047 (Role User, created 19/11) signed in on the handheld and downloaded the data; name and username shown on the Dashboard. (After the user was deleted, the open session kept syncing: htx-lims-web BUG-014.)

tests.title: The handheld shows the item type name for an item of a newly added type
tests.goal: Items of an item type created after the handheld last downloaded its lists still show the type name, not its id.
preconditions: An item type added in Master Data > Item Type today, with one item IN (QA data)

steps.text: On the handheld tap Update all data
Open Check-out, enter the item number and tap Find item
Look at the item card, then Add to list

expected.text: The card shows "Type: <type name> · Consumable" (as in Pre Check-in and Check-in), not a number

notes: Check-out of 002000026 showed "102 · Consumable · Checked in" instead of the type name.

Not a mobile test pass: handheld steps done while testing htx-lims-web on 19/11 (after the deploy), emulator Medium_Phone, recorded for traceability. HLM-013 only partly (No Return, not For Use): not recorded.
